title: Staging gameday config pack for controlled regional failover rehearsal
author: Benji Okafor
description: Summary: Adds a versioned “staging gameday” configuration preset for rehearsing controlled regional failovers with a constrained blast radius (safe endpoints, limited tenants/models, tight rate limits) and predictable observability. Motivation: Our previous rehearsals required hand-edits across Helm values + routing config + alert silences; that led to drift and missed safety toggles. This PR introduces a single config pack that can be applied/rolled back quickly and is explicitly designed for the Q1 failover game day run-of-show. What’s included: (1) Helm values preset `values-staging-gameday.yaml` that enables failover-controller in staging with `dry_run=true` by default, and a separate `execute_enabled` flag gated behind an explicit override; (2) Policy engine preset that constrains evaluation + actions to an allowlist of tenants and routes, and limits models to a small rehearsal set; (3) Routing config “safe endpoints” mode which forces the controller to use simulate/plan endpoints unless `execute_enabled` is true; (4) Default rate limits/anti-flap timers tightened for rehearsals (max flips per hour, hold-down timers, and a global kill switch); (5) A standard set of dashboard annotations/tags so the rehearsal timeline is searchable and consistent; (6) `make staging-gameday-apply` / `make staging-gameday-revert` helper targets with explicit prompts and a printed verification checklist. Safety properties (staging): - Tenant allowlist required (empty allowlist == controller no-ops) - Model allowlist required - Controller starts in dry-run mode, execute path is hard-disabled unless explicitly overridden - Max 1 policy flip per 30 minutes per tenant/route (configurable) - Automatic rollback disabled in staging unless `enable_rollback=true` is set (to avoid masking signal issues during rehearsal); rollback can still be done manually via existing runbook steps - Hard cap on traffic shift percentage for rehearsal routes (default 15%) How to use (staging): 1) Apply preset: `make staging-gameday-apply TENANTS=tnt_123,tnt_456 MODELS=llama-3.1-8b-instruct,qwen2.5-7b-instruct` 2) Verify: check controller logs for “DRY_RUN active”; verify policy engine reports allowlist loaded; confirm dashboards show `gameday_config=enabled` annotation 3) Rehearse: use simulation endpoint + perf canary probes; capture controller recommendation output for the runbook 4) Revert: `make staging-gameday-revert` (restores prior values, removes annotations) Out of scope: No production defaults changed; no changes to trigger hierarchy or rollback semantics beyond staging-only preset values. Risks/mitigations: - Risk: someone enables execute in staging without realizing it can flip policies for rehearsal tenants; mitigation: execute requires explicit override and the Make target prints a confirmation block including the allowlist and “blast radius” summary. - Risk: config drift across clusters; mitigation: preset is versioned and referenced by runbook; CI validates schema and rejects missing allowlist fields. Testing: - Unit: config schema validation (policy + controller), Make target dry-run output snapshot - Integration (staging): applied to `staging-us-east` and confirmed controller in dry-run; verified simulate endpoint output includes allowlist + model constraints - Observability: verified annotations appear on Failover Signals dashboard and can be filtered by `gameday_config` Rollout/ops notes: This is intended to be applied during rehearsals only. The runbook will reference this preset; follow-up PR will add it to the rehearsal checklist doc. Screenshots/log excerpts included in comments (see conversation).
commits: config: add staging gameday helm values preset for failover-controller
routing: add safe-endpoints mode and tenant/model allowlist enforcement for rehearsal
policy-engine: introduce config schema for rehearsal constraints + validation
build: add make targets for apply/revert and printed verification checklist
obs: add standard gameday annotations/tags for dashboards
review_summary: Miles Thornton: Requested explicit wording in Make target output to prevent accidental execute enablement; also asked to default `traffic_shift_cap_pct` to 10%. Benji: Updated prompt text and set cap to 15% with rationale (keeps signal visible under rehearsal load); added comment + override flag. Miles: Approved.

Mina Haddad: Asked whether safe-endpoints mode also covers redirect paths for streaming clients. Benji: Clarified this only affects controller execution endpoints; streaming behavior is handled elsewhere (linked ENG-2422). Approved with note to add a brief comment in docs snippet.
Ravi Menon: Requested schema validation to fail if TENANTS/MODELS allowlist is empty. Benji: Implemented hard validation (empty list => error) and added tests. Approved.

Allison Grant: Requested consistent annotation key naming and to avoid high-cardinality tags. Benji: Renamed to `gameday_config` and `gameday_run_id` with a fixed short run id; confirmed no per-tenant labels in annotations. Approved.

Tomáš Novák: Requested revert target to print what it changed and to restore previous values from a saved file. Benji: Added `values.staging-gameday.backup.yaml` save/restore behavior and printed diff summary. Approved.
release_notes: Staging-only: Introduces a versioned configuration preset to rehearse controlled regional failovers with tenant/model allowlists, safe-endpoints mode, and turnkey apply/revert targets for game days.
